name: research-match
description: MCP server with 24 tools that connects isolated researchers via AI originality scoring, bilateral matching, collaboration contracts, and privacy-first knowledge sharing.
long_description:
Research Match is an MCP server that helps researchers find complementary collaborators while protecting intellectual property. It uses AI-powered originality scoring on two independent axes (Theoretical Originality and Formal-Computational Originality) and bilateral matching with a semaphore system (GREEN/YELLOW/RED) that shows each researcher what they gain from a potential collaboration.

**KEY FEATURES (v3.0.0)**
- **AI Originality Scoring**: Dual-axis evaluation (OT/OFC) with solidity multipliers (proven, functional, speculative, adhoc, cherry_picked)
- **Bilateral Matching**: Complementarity-based matching with perspective-aware reasoning — each side sees gains from their own viewpoint
- **Privacy by Design**: Emails are SHA-256 hashed, pseudonymous identities, no raw content shared until collaboration is accepted
- **Reputation System**: Anti-retaliation ratings (anonymous until both rate), exponential smoothing, honesty-weighted
- **Cold Search**: Free search across internal DB and GitHub — no registration required
- **Deep Repository Analysis**: Clone and analyze any GitHub repo for originality scoring (stateless)
- **Universal Project Proforma**: 3-mode workflow (extract/validate/submit) for structured research commits
- **Collaboration Tickets**: Structured need_help/question/bug/suggestion tickets replacing free chat
- **Bilateral Reveal System**: Consent-based progressive disclosure of research commit content
- **Automatic Licensing**: 5-rule system (joint-equal, advisory-only, joint-weighted, time-limited)
- **File Sharing Registry**: Metadata-only file sharing with MAD re-sharing detection
- **Immutable Audit Log**: Full audit trail with viewer tool
- **Git-Verifiable Contracts**: Bilateral confirmation with git commit hash verification
- **Semantic Similarity**: sentence-transformers embeddings with Jaccard fallback

**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS**
- Python 3.12 or higher
- UV Package Manager
This MCP server requires UV, a fast Python package manager.
Installation:
`curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh`
For detailed installation instructions, [see the UV documentation](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv)

database_path.title: Database Path
database_path.description: Path to the SQLite database file. Leave empty to use the default (research_match.db in the extension directory).

tools.name: research_match_register
tools.description: STEP 1 — Register with a pseudonymous identity. Email is SHA-256 hashed and never stored in plain text. Idempotent: safe to call multiple times.

tools.name: research_match_analyze_work
tools.description: HELPER — Get the Research Commit template before submitting. Returns structured template with all fields and solidity guide.

tools.name: research_match_submit_commit
tools.description: STEP 2 — Submit a structured Research Commit for AI originality evaluation on two axes: Theoretical Originality (OT) and Formal-Computational Originality (OFC).

tools.name: research_match_my_profile
tools.description: View your Research Match profile: reputation, scores, commit history, and team memberships.

tools.name: research_match_find_collaborators
tools.description: STEP 3 — Find researchers with complementary skills. Returns candidates with bilateral semaphore (GREEN/YELLOW/RED) and perspective-aware reasoning.

tools.name: research_match_send_request
tools.description: STEP 4 — Send a collaboration request to a matched researcher. The recipient sees scores from their own perspective.

tools.name: research_match_inbox
tools.description: View all collaboration requests — incoming and outgoing — with semaphore, scores, and status.

tools.name: research_match_respond_request
tools.description: Accept or reject an incoming collaboration request. Acceptance creates a team with joint-equal licensing (50/50).

tools.name: research_match_rate_user
tools.description: Rate a collaborator on honesty, quality, and effort (1-5 each). Ratings are anonymous until both members rate.

tools.name: research_match_cold_search
tools.description: FREE cold search — no registration required. Searches internal DB and GitHub for research topics.

tools.name: research_match_deep_search
tools.description: Stateless deep analysis — clone and analyze any public GitHub repo for originality scoring, MCP gaps, and comparison with Research Match.

tools.name: research_match_prepare_commit
tools.description: Universal proforma — 3-mode workflow (extract/validate/submit) that analyzes a local repo and guides structured Research Commit submission.

tools.name: research_match_needs_create
tools.description: Create a structured collaboration ticket (need_help, question, bug, suggestion) within a team. Replaces free-form chat.

tools.name: research_match_needs_list
tools.description: List collaboration tickets for a team, optionally filtered by status (open/resolved) or type.

tools.name: research_match_needs_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a collaboration ticket. Resolver gets reputation effort boost if resolving another member's ticket.

tools.name: research_match_reveal_request
tools.description: Request consent to view a teammate's full Research Commit content. Part of the bilateral reveal system (Level 3).

tools.name: research_match_reveal_respond
tools.description: Approve or deny a reveal request. Approval triggers license recalculation.

tools.name: research_match_reveal_status
tools.description: View reveal consent matrix and approved commit content for a team. Includes shared files count.

tools.name: research_match_team_license
tools.description: View or recalculate the automatic license for a team. 5-rule system: joint-equal, advisory-only, joint-weighted, time-limited.

tools.name: research_match_share_file
tools.description: Share a file metadata entry with a team. Requires bilateral Level 3 reveals. MAD re-sharing detection protects against violations.

tools.name: research_match_shared_files
tools.description: List all shared file metadata entries for a team. Shows file paths, descriptions, and sharing history.

tools.name: research_match_audit_log
tools.description: Read-only viewer for the immutable audit trail. Filter by team and action type.

tools.name: research_match_export_contract
tools.description: Export a git-verifiable collaboration contract for a team. Includes parties, scores, license terms, and verification instructions.

tools.name: research_match_confirm_contract
tools.description: Confirm a collaboration contract with a git commit hash. Bilateral confirmation required (both members must confirm).
